record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, add a fixed residual path inside the recurrent encoder: replace each raw GRU output h_t with h_t+0.1*e_t, using the existing undropped, jointly trained item embedding e_t before the unchanged causal pooling readout. This may preserve recent-item identity alongside recurrent context. Retain the GRU backbone, input features, embedding parameterization, sequence selection, pooling, dot-product scoring, loss and optimizer. Update the predictor writer and architecture metadata.

category_rationales.rationale: Add a fixed 0.1 residual from the existing undropped item embedding to each GRU output before unchanged causal pooling. Apply this within each category’s single model, preserving embeddings, readout, scoring, loss and optimizer. The predictor imports the updated architecture and validates matching metadata.
